text: きみには　いつでも　おしえよう　また　くるがいい

structure.jp: いつでも　おしえよう

patterns.name: 〜がいい
patterns.explanation: A plain verb followed by がいい is a lofty, old-fashioned way of telling someone to do something, like 'you may' or 'go ahead and'. くるがいい = 'do come'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending says the speaker has decided to do something, like 'I shall'. おしえよう = 'I'll teach you'.
